title: Factorization of one canonical chart comparison
statement: Let H₀,Hₖ,H,K,L,A,B,C,D be schemes [def-pc-scheme], and write f* for abstract module pullback and P_f for tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Fix q₀:Hₖ→H₀, p₀:H→Hₖ, t₀:H→H₀ with p₀≫q₀=t₀; r₀:H₀→A, d:K→Hₖ, s:K→B, u:B→A with (d≫q₀)≫r₀=s≫u; v:H→C, u':C→A, k:H→A with t₀≫r₀=k=v≫u'; z:L→H, l:L→K with z≫p₀=l≫d; and r:L→D, w:D→B, δ:D→C with l≫s=r≫w, δ≫u'=w≫u and z≫v=r≫δ. Fix a module sheaf N on A. Let F=r₀*N and let σ:P_t₀≅P_q₀ followed by P_p₀ be the canonical tensor composition comparison [def-pc-tensor-pullback-composition-iso]. Let η_f:P_f≅f* be the canonical adjunction comparison [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Write c(g,f,h) for pullbackCompOfEq g f h with the specified map equality. Define E:P_p₀ followed by z*≅d* followed by l* as z*η_p₀, then composition along z,p₀, congruence along z≫p₀=l≫d, then inverse composition along l,d. Let τ=η_t₀(F)≫c(t₀,r₀,k)≫c(v,u',k)⁻¹ and s'=d*η_q₀(F)≫comp(d,q₀)(F)≫c(d≫q₀,r₀,s≫u)≫comp(s,u)(N)⁻¹; these are the direct and stage model comparisons [lem-pc-overlap-conjugate-restriction]. Let Cδ=comp(w,u)(N)≫congr((δ≫u')=(w≫u))⁻¹(N)≫comp(δ,u')(N)⁻¹, and define ξ=z*τ≫c(z,v,r≫δ)(u'*N)≫comp(r,δ)(u'*N)⁻¹≫r*(Cδ⁻¹). Finally let β=c(l,s,r≫w)(u*N)≫comp(r,w)(u*N)⁻¹. Then ξ=z*(σ(F))≫E(P_q₀F)≫l*(s')≫β, an equality of isomorphisms z*P_t₀F≅r*w*u*N. Compositions are in Lean order. No overlap transition or morphism between module sheaves is assumed.

proof.text: Expand the direct and stage model comparisons and the tensor composition isomorphism. Use the canonical adjunction comparison and the conjugation equivalence to identify the tensor compositor with the corresponding abstract pullback composition comparison.

Apply Scheme.Modules.pseudofunctor_associativity componentwise to the composable scheme maps. The resulting pullback associativity, congruence naturality, and inverse cancellation identify the two iterated pullback routes. Naturality transports the chart comparison through pullbacks, while the supplied equations identify all composite scheme maps.

theorem overlap_model_chart_factorization
    {H₀ Hₖ H K L A B C D : Scheme.{u}}
    (q₀ : Hₖ ⟶ H₀) (p₀ : H ⟶ Hₖ) (t₀ : H ⟶ H₀) (h₀ : p₀ ≫ q₀ = t₀)
    (r₀ : H₀ ⟶ A) (d : K ⟶ Hₖ) (s : K ⟶ B) (u : B ⟶ A)
    (hk : (d ≫ q₀) ≫ r₀ = s ≫ u)
    (v : H ⟶ C) (u' : C ⟶ A) (k : H ⟶ A)
    (htr : t₀ ≫ r₀ = k) (hvu : v ≫ u' = k)
    (z : L ⟶ H) (l : L ⟶ K) (hz : z ≫ p₀ = l ≫ d)
    (r : L ⟶ D) (w : D ⟶ B) (δ : D ⟶ C)
    (hl : l ≫ s = r ≫ w) (hδ : δ ≫ u' = w ≫ u) (hzv : z ≫ v = r ≫ δ)
    (N : A.Modules) :
    let F := (Scheme.Modules.pullback r₀).obj N
    let σ := Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackCompositionIso p₀ q₀ t₀ h₀
    let E := Functor.isoWhiskerRight (overlapAdjunctionComparison p₀)
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback z) ≪≫
      Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp z p₀ ≪≫ Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr hz ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp l d).symm
    let τ := overlapDirectModelComparison t₀ r₀ k v u' htr hvu N
    let ξ := (Scheme.Modules.pullback z).mapIso τ ≪≫
      pullbackCompOfEq z v (r ≫ δ) hzv ((Scheme.Modules.pullback u').obj N) ≪≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp r δ).app _).symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback r).mapIso
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp w u).app N ≪≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr hδ.symm).app N ≪≫
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp δ u').app N).symm).symm
    let s' := overlapStageModelComparison d q₀ r₀ s u hk N
    let β := pullbackCompOfEq l s (r ≫ w) hl ((Scheme.Modules.pullback u).obj N) ≪≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp r w).app _).symm
    ξ = (Scheme.Modules.pullback z).mapIso (σ.app F) ≪≫
      E.app ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback q₀).obj F) ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback l).mapIso s' ≪≫ β
